body_markdown:
GARLAND, TX (Apr 20, 2026) — Massimo Group has appointed Quenton Petersen as Chief Executive Officer, effective April 14, 2026. David Shan moves to Executive Chairman and stays actively involved in the company's strategic direction and operations.


Petersen has been with Massimo for more than nine years and has played a key role in the company's growth.


"I'm honored to step into the CEO role at a pivotal time for Massimo Group," said Petersen. "Over the past nine years, I've seen firsthand the strength of our manufacturing capabilities and our platform across utility vehicles and electric mobility."


"Quenton has been instrumental to Massimo's success, and I have full confidence in his leadership," said Shan. "I look forward to continuing to work closely with him and the team as Executive Chairman."
